name: shipwithai-fixkit
description: ShipWithAI Fixkit — a stack-agnostic, layer-aware bug-fix engine for Claude Code. Phase 0 ships the reusable core; platform adapters and the ShipWithAI pack arrive in later phases.

plugins.name: shipwithai-fixkit-core
plugins.description: Stack-agnostic, layer-aware bug-fix engine. Classify by symptom layer, debug on a vendored systematic-debugging spine, close only on layer-appropriate proof.

plugins.name: shipwithai-fixkit-web
plugins.description: Thin web adapter for the fixkit engine: maps ~~connectors to concrete web tooling (Claude in Chrome, astro dev, node/vitest) and ships per-layer reproduce/verify/source-map recipes for an Astro + content-collections stack. No debugging logic — that lives in core.
